verticalDatum: Native TINITALY 1.1 heights relative to the mapped piazza approach.

contact.basis: Native bare-earth TINITALY elevation at the center of the eastern stair approach.

attribution: Tarquini S., I. Isola, M. Favalli, A. Battistini, G. Dotta (2023), TINITALY 1.1, INGV, CC BY 4.0.
method: Grid-aligned bare-earth INGV WCS crop in native UTM zone 32N, bilinearly sampled without flattening or replacing cells.
limitations: The native 10 m cells capture the ground slope and do not describe individual stair treads or roofs.
